walk.title: Dadi ji's slow loop
walk.intro: Come, beta. Shoes on, phone in the pocket. We are only going to walk slowly and look at ordinary things.

stops.title: Slow start
stops.say: Walk at half your usual speed. If somebody overtakes you, let them. Today you are not late for anything.

stops.title: Three trees
stops.say: Find three different trees. Don't worry about their names. Notice which one has the oldest looking bark.

stops.title: Count the sounds
stops.say: Stand still and count the different sounds you can hear. A crow, a scooter, someone's pressure cooker, it all counts.

stops.title: Something rough
stops.say: Find something rough to touch, a wall or some bark. Press your palm on it for a moment. Your hands like the outdoors too, beta.

stops.title: Just sit
stops.say: Find somewhere to sit, or lean. Look at one thing until it stops being boring. Then keep looking.

walk.outro: Wah, beta. See, the world was still here. Now go home and drink your chai.
walk.notice: Which sound was the farthest away?

walk.title: Case of the quiet gully
walk.intro: Detective, aaj ek case hai. Phone jeb mein rakho. Hum bas ek gali ka rahasya suljhane nikle hain.

stops.title: Investigation shuru
stops.say: Dheere chalo, jaise tumhe kuch pata hai jo kisi ko nahi pata. Har mod par ruko aur dekho, kuch alag hai kya?

stops.title: Pehla suraag
stops.say: Ek aisi cheez dhundo jo sabko dikhti hai par koi dekhta nahi. Purani deewar, tooti khidki, kuch bhi. Wahi tumhara pehla suraag hai.

stops.title: Gawah
stops.say: Ek minute ruko aur sunno. Koi to gawah hai yahan. Kaun si awaaz sabse door se aa rahi hai?

stops.title: Parchhaiyan
stops.say: Apni parchhai ko dekho. Kya wo tumse zyada tez chal rahi hai? Ek aur parchhai dhundo jo hil rahi ho.

stops.title: Case closed
stops.say: Kahin baith jao. Culprit mil gaya: ek gilehri. Lekin wo bhi sirf apna kaam kar rahi thi.

walk.outro: Case closed, detective. Ab ghar chalo, aur chai peekar report likh lo.
walk.notice: Aaj ka sabse bada suraag kya tha?

walk.title: धीमी चाल
walk.intro: फ़ोन जेब में रख दीजिए। आज हम बस धीरे-धीरे चलेंगे।

stops.title: धीमी चाल
stops.say: आराम से चलिए। हर क़दम पर पैर के नीचे की ज़मीन महसूस कीजिए।

stops.title: आवाज़ें
stops.say: रुकिए। कान खोल दीजिए। कितनी आवाज़ें हैं, बस गिन लीजिए।

stops.title: एक पेड़
stops.say: एक पेड़ चुनिए। उसे ऐसे देखिए जैसे पहली बार देख रहे हों।

stops.title: ठहरना
stops.say: कहीं बैठ जाइए। कुछ मत कीजिए। बस साँस लीजिए।

walk.outro: अब लौट चलिए। दुनिया वहीं थी, आप भी।
